result.summary: The page is largely well-formed: the header, location, search bar, promo banner, carousel, and bottom navigation align cleanly with consistent spacing. The only visible defect is a glyph rendering problem in the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen', which displays as 'Rameı'. Clipped carousel items and the partially visible bottom card were excluded as intended features.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' renders its final 'n' as a dotless-i-like glyph ('Rameı'), which looks like a font or character-encoding rendering error.
issues.suggestion: Verify the font file includes the full Latin character set and that the text is encoded as standard UTF-8 'n'. Check for stray or substituted characters in the source data.

issues.description: The search placeholder text and secondary metadata (delivery fees, delivery times) are light gray on white or light gray backgrounds, which may fall below recommended contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder and secondary text colors to meet WCAG AA contrast of at least 4.5:1 for normal text.
